course: an illustrated online course on synthesizers and the physics of sound
intro: Each lesson opens on a puzzle from the history of sound (a scientist, an engineer or a musician who heard something they couldn't explain) and works it out on a live synth the reader plays, in the plain, concrete voice of the site's Geology course. Knob names in the text (Cutoff, Reso, Env amt, Width, Depth, Dest) match the synth's panel and must not change, nor may task wording that names a knob's setting.
